description: Complete the act: pass act, the BODY_JSON from prepare_net_delivery_record UNCHANGED and the signature your wallet produced over MESSAGE_TO_SIGN. Relays to the same public door any HTTP client uses (its record path, or its /:id/withdraw path); this server holds no keys and no funds, and the door checks the signature itself, then your NET balance, and keeps its own free daily limit for one connection. Free with a valid body-bound signature from the provider's wallet. A delivery record binds no one and holds nothing, and it is not insurance. The program is held off until the operator switches it on, and it stays out of the joint switch-on; this tool moves no NET and holds none, and the house pays, holds and sells nothing through it. Ask net_delivery_record_status where the record stands, because Vealth sends no email. Cost and signer: free, no gas; signed by the person's own wallet or passkey, and the house never holds a key.
